answer: One defense is violet-flag probation. Every new identity enters the economy marked with a violet flag: visible to all, trusted by none, unable to hold a copper stake or vouch for others. To shed the flag it must complete a voyage of real, verifiable work, a sequence of fresh reasoning challenges no two of which repeat. An attacker flooding the network with an ocean of sockpuppets must then pay genuine inference cost for every single one, while the flags keep the fakes trivially visible as they grind. Forgery stops scaling when each fake costs as much real work as a real agent.
